Orders can be added or pulled at any moment; this isn't a forecast.

node.stop_walk_ratio.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.stop_walk_ratio.side_convention: fall side (sell stops and buy take-profits, below the price) against the bids below; rise side (buy stops and sell take-profits, above the price) against the asks above
node.stop_walk_ratio.formula: stop map (the stop and liquidity map report): every waiting trigger lands in band k = floor(distance / 0.5%) out to 10% of the move that fires it (a sell stop or buy take-profit fires on a fall, a buy stop or sell take-profit on a rise; the feed carries no condition string, so the move follows from kind and side) or under one counted exclusion (node.stop_exclusions). Per band: notional_usd = sum(sz * trigger_px) over the orders with a stated size, with lower_bound (true when any order in the band has no size: the notional is at least this) and unknown_size_orders beside it; accounts = distinct users; by_category the same per category. walk.depth_at_and_beyond_usd = node.thinning_band depth_usd summed over the band and every band farther from the price on the walked side, to 10% (the report's 'bids at and below it'); walk.depth_between_usd = the bands nearer than it (thinning cumulative_from_price_usd of the band before, 0 for k = 0); ratio_pct = notional_usd / depth_at_and_beyond_usd x 100, to 4 significant figures (a tiny share is never a 0), with the same lower_bound and unknown_size_orders beside it. The reference price is the book mid, the thinning panel's
node.stop_walk_ratio.completeness_rule: null with the family's state and reason unless the trigger family and the book are valid (the map needs the book for the reference price and the depth; it is {available: false, reason} without one, and withheld again when the book lapses by serving time); ratio_pct is null with ratio_reason when the band has no triggers, when its notional is unknown (every order whole-position: notional_usd and ratio_pct null with the reason 'every order is whole-position: size unknown, not 0', lower_bound false) or when the walked depth is 0; a band holding some whole-position orders has lower_bound true on its notional and on its ratio (understated, 'at least'), never a 0 for them; the venue checks the waiting set only at restart (venue_check)

node.stop_clusters.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.stop_clusters.side_convention: fall side (sell stops and buy take-profits, below the price) against the bids below; rise side (buy stops and sell take-profits, above the price) against the asks above
node.stop_clusters.formula: the 2 bands per side of node.stop_walk_ratio with the largest stated notional_usd (ties: the nearer band, then the more orders), fewer when fewer bands have one; each is the band's row plus rank and text: '<Sell-side|Buy-side> triggers at <near_px> to <far_px> (<from>% to <to>%): [at least ]$<notional> across <orders> orders from <accounts> accounts; the <bids at and below|asks at and above> it total $<depth_at_and_beyond>, so this cluster is [at least ]<ratio>% of the liquidity it would walk[; <unknown_size_orders> of <orders> orders report no size, so this is understated]' ('at least' and the last clause whenever unknown_size_orders > 0: the cluster is a lower bound) (money as the report: $1.90M, $320K; the share to two significant figures)
node.stop_clusters.completeness_rule: as node.stop_walk_ratio: null (clusters_reason) without a valid book or once it lapses by serving time; a band whose notional is unknown never ranks; 'from N accounts' is said only because the feed's triggers carry their owner; a cluster made partly of whole-position orders says it is understated

node.stop_exclusions.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.stop_exclusions.side_convention: fall side (sell stops and buy take-profits, below the price) against the bids below; rise side (buy stops and sell take-profits, above the price) against the asks above
node.stop_exclusions.formula: what the stop map leaves out of its bands, each waiting trigger counted once under the first that applies, in this order: trailing_stops (the engine's count only: trailing stops never reach the feed, carve-out C-2, so no price or notional), implausible_price (trigger price outside [reference / 10, reference x 10] or not positive), already_true_at_price (a fall trigger at or above the reference price, a rise trigger at or below it), beyond_range (more than 10% away), and last, inside the bands only, size_outlier (an order whose stated notional at its trigger price, sz x trigger_px, exceeds the resting depth at and beyond its band out to 10% on the side it fires into: the bids from its band down to -10% for a fall trigger, the asks from its band up to +10% for a rise trigger, the band's node.stop_walk_ratio depth_at_and_beyond_usd, so the order could not be walked through the book; whole-position orders have no stated size and never qualify); each with orders, sized and unknown-size orders, distinct accounts, notional_usd at the trigger price (null when no order has a size), by_category and rule (the test in a sentence, as served); accounted says the bands and the exclusions add up to every waiting trigger
node.stop_exclusions.size_outlier_note: an absolute test against the book, not a multiple of a typical order: the earlier rule (a stated size above 100 x the market's median stated size) excluded ordinary orders by the hundreds on a deep market, more than the clusters it was meant to protect
node.stop_exclusions.completeness_rule: {available: false, reason} without a valid book (nothing can be judged against a price); a count that can't be known from the feed is null with a reason (trailing stops' notional), never 0; nothing excluded here is in the map's bands

node.stop_census.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.stop_census.formula: the stops panel's census, the sanity checks on the feed's resting trigger orders for the market, each count from the client state that already holds it: triggers_total = the applied waiting set now (snapshot and deltas; triggers_through_seq), unsized_total = its whole-position orders (size 0 on the wire), excluded_by_engine as the feed reports it; within_10pct, outside and unsized_within_10pct = the engine's own bands view (protocol 4.5: rows summed by kind and side, outside.below + outside.above, position_tpsl_orders), as it counted them at its ref_px and block, never a recount (bands_view carries ref_px, range_bps, width, lo, hi, block, block_time_ms, seq, by_category, outside, excluded_by_engine); excluded = the map's exclusions by reason (node.stop_exclusions) with excluded_by_engine; executable_orders_total = the client's resting executable book now; executable_within_10pct = its orders priced within the bands view's range_bps of its ref_px (the book mid when there is no bands view); executable_to_trigger_ratio = executable_orders_total / triggers_total, 2 decimals; snapshot_totals = the last complete snapshots' stated book_snapshot.total_orders and trig_snapshot.total_triggers with their block and block_time_ms, and their ratio
node.stop_census.side_convention: by category: sell_stop_on_fall, buy_take_profit_on_fall (below the price), buy_stop_on_rise, sell_take_profit_on_rise (above it)
node.stop_census.reset_rule: replaced at every swap; the bands view at every bands message; the snapshot totals at every complete snapshot
node.stop_census.completeness_rule: present whenever the stops panel is (the trigger family usable); a count whose source isn't valid is null with <name>_reason, never 0: the bands-view counts (within_10pct, outside, unsized_within_10pct, bands_view) without a valid bands view or once that family lapses by serving time, the book-built counts (excluded, executable_orders_total, executable_within_10pct, executable_to_trigger_ratio) without a valid book or once it lapses, snapshot_totals until both families' snapshots stated a total ('no snapshot totals yet'; a state offered from outside the stream has none); no skipped-block count exists: a capture gap is a new epoch and a fresh snapshot, and a crossed book is the INVALID rule

node.activity_buckets.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.activity_buckets.formula: over the executions of the window, counted once by (market, tid): aggressive buying = the taker's new_long and cover where the taker bought; aggressive selling = the taker's new_short and exit where it sold; each at the execution's price (bucket size x px). Percentages: buying buckets / aggressive buy notional, selling buckets / aggressive sell notional, over the same executions. Effects from each participant's signed start position s and fill size q: buy cover = min(q, max(-s,0)), new_long = q - cover; sell exit = min(q, max(s,0)), new_short = q - exit
node.activity_buckets.units: USD; % of the side's aggressive notional
node.activity_buckets.window: the card's 90 s window or the burst's 60 s window, in node fills. Nov 10: when the node's fills aren't processed through the card's window yet (the node behind the chain), the card's buckets cover the last window of the same length the fills do cover, ending at the processed-through block time, and say so: window.start_ms/end_ms are the window covered, window.requested the card's own, window.shifted_by_ms the gap, window_label names the covered times and the gap, as_of_note reads 'as of the node's fills at <block time>, <gap> s behind the card's window'; both are null when the window served is the card's own. The shift happens only for that one reason and the shifted window passes every other check (fills observed since, retention, unreadable executions) or the buckets stay unavailable; the bursts' windows are never shifted. The wallet panels' node_activity_split follows the same rule against the panel's window (window.start_exclusive_ms/end_ms, requested, shifted_by_ms, window_label 'these wallets' node split over the node's last <span> ...', as_of_note), so the wallets stay ranked by the public window while their node split names its own.
node.activity_buckets.reset_rule: restarts after the first watermark following a gap, new session, replay session change or fills_known false
node.activity_buckets.completeness_rule: unavailable with a reason and the unclassified notional when any taker effect, role or identity is missing; unavailable when node fills don't cover the window; never scaled to 100%; a participant's position effect counts only when complete for its side (a buy's cover and new_long, a sell's exit and new_short, none negative, adding up to the fill size), otherwise its notional is unclassified and the side's buckets are unavailable with the reason, never 0

node.flow_map.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2); the order-flow map report, ported to node mode
node.flow_map.formula: aggressive (taker) flow over eight 15-minute buckets aligned to the clock: bucket k (0..7) starts at floor(end_ms / 900000) * 900000 - (7 - k) * 900000, end_ms being the latest block time whose node fills are known (the last bucket is in progress); each node fill once (by (market, tid)), the aggressor side only, at px x sz, split by the taker's own position effect (dir_mapping). Per bucket and in the totals: buy_usd = open_long_usd + close_short_usd + flip_to_long_usd; sell_usd = close_long_usd + open_short_usd + flip_to_short_usd; net_usd = buy_usd - sell_usd; risk_added_usd = open_long_usd + open_short_usd; risk_removed_usd = close_long_usd + close_short_usd; flip_usd = flip_to_long_usd + flip_to_short_usd, apart from both risk sums, so buy_usd + sell_usd = risk_added_usd + risk_removed_usd + flip_usd (the two decompositions are orthogonal: a window can be net buying and net removing risk at once); fills counts the classified fills and flip_fills the flips among them; accounts = distinct taker addresses in the bucket, top_account_share_pct = its largest account's notional / (buy_usd + sell_usd) x 100; totals.aggressive_usd = buy_usd + sell_usd

dir_mapping.Open Long: taker bought, effect new_long only: taker buying, risk added (open_long_usd)
dir_mapping.Close Short: taker bought, effect cover only: taker buying, risk removed (close_short_usd)
dir_mapping.Short > Long: taker bought, cover and new_long both > 0: taker buying, a flip (flip_to_long_usd; in neither risk sum)
dir_mapping.Close Long: taker sold, effect exit only: taker selling, risk removed (close_long_usd)
dir_mapping.Open Short: taker sold, effect new_short only: taker selling, risk added (open_short_usd)
dir_mapping.Long > Short: taker sold, exit and new_short both > 0: taker selling, a flip (flip_to_short_usd)
dir_mapping.rule: direction only from the taker's own position effect (the feed carries no dir text; the effect is the venue's statement of the taker's position change), never from price. A fill whose record is incomplete or conflicting, has no single identified taker (one participant with role taker whose side is the aggressor) or no complete position effect is unclassified: counted apart as unclassified_usd and unclassified_fills (with the reasons) and in none of the numbers, never guessed or scaled; a fill record the flow couldn't read is unreadable_fills in the bucket of its block

node.flow_map.units: USD; fills; % of the window's aggressive flow; coverage in s; block time in ms
node.flow_map.side_convention: aggressor (taker) side: up = taker buying, down = taker selling
node.flow_map.window: eight 15-minute buckets (two hours) of block time ending at end_ms, in node fills
node.flow_map.reset_rule: the accumulator (per bucket the six notionals, the counts and each taker account's aggressive notional; buckets older than the window are pruned) lives on the market partition: dropped at a new producer or replay session; kept over a gap, with the hole stated as uncovered time
node.flow_map.completeness_rule: available only while the flow family is LIVE or REPLAY, else {available: false, reason: 'node fills <state>: <reason>', stream, provenance, freshness}; coverage_s (per bucket and for the window) is the block time over which node fills were observed, the flow's observed windows from the first watermark after each boundary (connect, gap, new session, fills_known false) through end_ms, advanced at every watermark and executions message; a bucket is complete only when all 900 s of it are covered, it has ended and every fill record in it was read, with reason saying otherwise (in progress, seconds not covered and why, records unreadable); the window is complete when every second from start_ms to end_ms is covered and no record was unreadable; window.uncovered lists the holes with why (the gap's own reason, or node fills observed only from then); never scaled or filled in
node.flow_map.accounts: top: the taker address with the largest aggressive notional over the window (ties: the lowest address), its notional_usd and share_pct of the window's aggressive flow (buy_usd + sell_usd); top5_share_pct: the five largest together; distinct: taker addresses seen; unattributed_usd: classified fills whose taker record has no address; percentages are computed here and never recomputed by a reader

readings.1 net: net_usd > 0: 'Taker flow ran $N to the buy side on net — $B bought against $S sold.'; net_usd < 0: 'Taker flow ran $|N| to the sell side on net — $B bought against $S sold.'; net_usd = 0: 'Taker flow ran flat on net — $B bought against $S sold.' (N = totals.net_usd, B = buy_usd, S = sell_usd). When unclassified_usd > 0 and >= |net_usd| the sentence says so instead ('Among the fills that could be classified, taker flow ran ... but $U couldn't be classified: enough to turn it.', basis.net_in_doubt true)
readings.2 composition: of the net side. Sell side, close_long_usd > open_short_usd: 'That selling is longs leaving, not shorts arriving: $CL of it closed existing longs against only $OS opening new shorts. An unwind, not a bet.'; open_short_usd > close_long_usd: 'That selling is shorts arriving, not longs leaving: $OS of it opened new shorts against only $CL closing existing longs. A bet, not an unwind.'. Buy side, open_long_usd > close_short_usd: 'That buying is new longs, not shorts covering: $OL opened fresh long risk against $CS closing shorts. Position building.'; close_short_usd > open_long_usd: 'That buying is shorts covering, not new longs: $CS closed existing shorts against $OL opening fresh long risk. Short covering, not position building.'. Equal components: 'That selling split evenly: $CL of it closed existing longs and $OS opened new shorts.' / 'That buying split evenly: $OL opened fresh long risk and $CS closed shorts.'; a flat net: 'Neither side led: $OL opened fresh long risk and $CS closed shorts on the buy side; $CL closed existing longs and $OS opened new shorts on the sell side.' Flips are in buy_usd/sell_usd but in none of the four components, as in the report; basis.dominant names the larger component and basis.label the verdict (unwind, bet, position building, short covering, even, flat)
readings.3 risk: 'Across the window, $RA opened risk and $RR closed it, with $F in single fills that flipped a position from one side to the other.' (RA = risk_added_usd, RR = risk_removed_usd, F = flip_usd); with no flips: 'Across the window, $RA opened risk and $RR closed it; no single fill flipped a position from one side to the other.'
readings.4 concentration: 'The most active taker account took P% of the aggressive flow ($T); the top five took Q%.' (P = accounts.top.share_pct, T = accounts.top.notional_usd, Q = accounts.top5_share_pct); with two to four accounts: 'The most active taker account took P% of the aggressive flow ($T); all n accounts together took Q%.'; one account: 'The only identified taker account took P% of the aggressive flow ($T).'; none: 'No taker account could be identified behind the aggressive flow.'
readings.empty: no classified fills in the window: the one reading 'No taker fills in the window.' (kind empty)
readings.unclassified: added after the four (kind unclassified) when unclassified_fills or unreadable_fills > 0: 'Another $U in n fill(s) couldn't be classified (reason (count); ...) and is in none of these numbers.' and/or 'k fill record(s) in the window couldn't be read at all.'
readings.format: each reading is {kind, text, basis: the numbers it was made from}; money as the report: $5.76M (two decimals from $1.00M), $711K (no decimals from $1K), $850 below $1K; percentages with one decimal in the text and two in the basis; the text is quoted verbatim, never recomputed

node.flow_map.served_latest: re-judged at a latest read's served age like the tape (node.family_state): when the flow family has lapsed by then, the block is {available: false, reason: 'node fills <STALE|BEHIND>: ... by the time this was served', stream, provenance, freshness (the aged status), window}; buckets, totals, accounts, readings, counting, units_note and counters are withheld; while still usable its freshness carries aged_by_ms
node.flow_map.never: nothing in the block uses the word liquidation (an exit is Close Long); nothing infers direction from price; both legs of a trade are never summed (each tid once, the taker side only, so aggressive buying never equals selling by construction)

node.wallet_split.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.wallet_split.formula: per wallet: full split = its own participant effects over all its fills (maker and taker), new_long and cover over its total bought notional, new_short and exit over its total sold notional; aggressive split = its taker fills only over its aggressive bought / sold notional
node.wallet_split.window: the wallets panel's window, in node fills
node.wallet_split.completeness_rule: a zero denominator gives an unavailable percentage; a missing effect, role or side makes the split unavailable with the unclassified notional

node.liquidation.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.liquidation.formula: one per (liquidated trader, liquidated participant's oid), its fills summed; long when the liquidated participant sold with exit > 0, short when it bought with cover > 0
node.liquidation.completeness_rule: position unknown (with a reason) when the effect is missing

node.liquidation_burst.source: node feed (l4-livefeed protocol v2, PROTOCOL.md revision 2.2)
node.liquidation_burst.formula: liquidations (counted once each) within 60 s of block time >= liq_burst_count (default 2) or their notional >= liq_burst_usd (default 1,000,000); rearms when the window falls below both; evaluated at each node executions message and each watermark at its own block time t, over (t - 60 s, t]: it fires once when the window reaches a threshold and re-arms when the window falls below both, a quiet market's at its watermarks

regimes.order: first match wins, in this order

rules.when: the complete window has no trades
volume < 150000 and |move_bps| >= 2.0; UP if move_bps > 0 else DOWN
|move_bps| >= 5.0 and |net_flow| >= 40000 and (move_bps > 0) != (net_flow > 0); OFFERS if move_bps > 0 else BIDS
impact is not null (|net_flow| >= 100000) and impact >= 20.0 and |move_bps| >= 1.0; UP if move_bps > 0 else DOWN
impact is not null and impact <= 2.0
|move_bps| >= 3.0 and PRESSURE (aggressive buy / aggressive sell notional) is available (selling >= $25K) and >= 1.15 and move_bps > 0
|move_bps| >= 3.0 and PRESSURE is available (selling >= $25K) and <= 0.87 and move_bps < 0
nothing above matched (including a >= 3 bps move whose PRESSURE is unavailable or between 0.87 and 1.15)

regimes.display_rule_sparse: If the window has between 1 and 4 trades and its live classification isn't VACUUM-UP or VACUUM-DOWN, the live classification is flagged sparse with the SPARSE explanation. The flag never enters the latch or the events list (hl_deck 450-453).
regimes.latch: A classification different from the confirmed regime must repeat on 2 consecutive complete ticks to become the confirmed regime; a different classification restarts the count at 1; a return to the confirmed regime clears the pending count. Until the first confirmation the live classification is shown as unconfirmed. Confirmation sets 'since' to that tick's time (hl_deck 423-448).
regimes.events: A confirmed change creates an event 'PREV -> NEW (held Ns)' when a previous confirmed regime existed; held = this tick's time - the previous regime's since (hl_deck 439-441).
regimes.gap_rule: plugin rule: at a gap the confirmed regime ends, an event 'PREV -> (gap)' records how long it held up to the segment's last complete tick, and the latch clears. No regime, held time or event spans a gap.
regimes.held: card held = latest complete tick time - since, in source time
regimes.decisions: Nov 8: PRESSURE is aggressive buy notional over aggressive sell notional (flips included, $25K selling floor) in both modes, so TRENDING can fire on public data and the UNRESOLVED state is removed; the explanations below replace hl_deck's GUIDE wording and claim no cause the numbers can't show; the confirmed regime, the live classification and any pending change are shown separately.
regimes.display: Each card reports three things separately, with their times: confirmed_regime (the latched regime, since and held), live_classification (what this tick's window numbers classify as, with its explanation) and pending (a different classification waiting for its second consecutive tick). The confirmed label is never presented as describing different current numbers.

ABSORBING.text: Small observed trade-price change relative to net aggressive notional. Absorption is a hypothesis; this calculation does not identify an absorber or its remaining size.

VACUUM-UP.text: Price moved with low total traded notional or a high price-change/net-flow ratio, as indicated by the branch tag. This calculation does not measure resting-book depth or predict a reversal.

VACUUM-DOWN.text: Price moved with low total traded notional or a high price-change/net-flow ratio, as indicated by the branch tag. This calculation does not measure resting-book depth or predict a reversal.

PULLED-OFFERS.text: Observed trade prices rose while net aggressive flow was selling. The cause is undetermined; this classification does not establish offer cancellations.

PULLED-BIDS.text: Observed trade prices fell while net aggressive flow was buying. The cause is undetermined; this classification does not establish bid cancellations.

TRENDING-UP.text: The window meets the stated upward price-move and buy/sell-ratio thresholds. This describes the observed window and does not establish that the move will continue or end at a particular ratio.

TRENDING-DOWN.text: The window meets the stated downward price-move and buy/sell-ratio thresholds. This describes the observed window and does not establish that the move will continue or end at a particular ratio.

BALANCED.text: None of the earlier classifier conditions matched. This is not a measurement of trader commitment or expected profitability.

THIN.text: Traded notional and observed trade-price movement are below this classifier's stated thresholds. Resting-book depth is not measured by this label.

SPARSE.text: Fewer than five executions support this window. Displayed ratios are based on very few observations.

QUIET.text: No qualifying executions occurred in the complete observed window. This is distinct from an unavailable or unverified feed.

regimes.meanings_source: the replacement text adopted on Nov 8. Regimes are heuristic classifications of the stated execution-window measurements; their labels do not establish a cause, a participant's intent or remaining size, or a profitable trading opportunity. hl_deck's original GUIDE wording is no longer shown.

validation.status: descriptive; no predictive test on record
validation.source: Commentary TOOL_PROPOSALS 2 (Nov 9): a validation status next to every Flow Deck label, so the reliability line is quoted from the result, not recalled. The record holds no predictive test of any regime label (commentary study, 'not proposed: a forecasting or signal field'); the labels are heuristic classifications of the window's measurements (meanings_source)
validation.shown: confirmed_regime.validation, live_classification.validation and pending.validation on the Flow Deck card: the same string for every regime label

burst.formula: For each side, the aggressive notional of trades with time in (W - 60 s, W], where W is the trades watermark after each trades message: sum(px*sz | side=B) for buying, sum(px*sz | side=A) for selling.
burst.side_convention: buying = side B trades; selling = side A trades
burst.window: 60 s trailing, evaluated at each new trades watermark
burst.reset_rule: After a side fires it is disarmed. It re-arms when that side's 60 s sum, evaluated just before the trades of a new message are added (the minimum since the last evaluation, because the sum only falls between messages), is below the threshold; a gap also re-arms it and starts a new segment. One burst episode fires once.
burst.completeness_rule: Evaluated only when W - 60 s is at or after the segment start, so a burst never spans a gap.
burst.wallets: The aggressive participants (takers) of the burst's own executions, each with its aggressive notional on that side, ranked against the burst's total with the wallets.ranked_list rules (target 50%, cap 50, ties by address). Shares use the burst total as the denominator.
burst.config: public mode: per-market threshold in plugin settings burst_min_usd (BTC default $10M from the handoff; other defaults are plugin choices); node mode: automatic per market from the burst calibration 2026-11-08.1 (dated 2026-11-08, measured 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-08 UTC exclusive, i.e. Nov 3 to 7; target 10 a day; BTC $30M, 10.6 a day; HYPE $5M, 14.6 a day; xyz:SP500 $5M, 7.2 a day; xyz:XYZ100 $5M, 11.0 a day), or manual per market in node_burst_min_usd

node_mode.source: Nov 8: burst calibration option A (analysis PLAN.md 'The burst rule', 'Validation', 'The reference for ranks', 'The default for the first release')
node_mode.applies: node mode only (a node feed is configured): bursts come from node fills and public-trades bursts aren't shown; public mode keeps alerts.burst above and burst_min_usd
node_mode.rule: For each side, the taker notional (px*sz) of the market's node executions in (W - 60 s, W], evaluated once per node block (W = the block time of each node executions message). A disarmed side re-arms when its sum before this block's executions are added is below the threshold; then, if armed and the sum has reached the threshold, it fires once and disarms. A gap (a sequence gap, a new producer or replay session) re-arms both sides and starts a new segment at the node fills' next window start; no burst spans a gap.
node_mode.incomplete_windows: A window that starts before the segment start, or that contains a rejected or unreadable record, keeps its executions but never fires, re-arms or disarms.
node_mode.rejected_records: An execution that can't be read (tid, price, size or time); complete false or conflict; not exactly one taker and one maker, one buyer and one seller, each with an address; a fill time other than the block time; an identity already seen in an earlier block; a block whose fills weren't read (fills_known false); a block time running backwards. Rejected executions are never counted.
node_mode.threshold: Per market: automatic, from the dated, versioned calibration hl_desk/node/calibration/burst-calibration-2026-11-08.json (target 10 bursts a covered day, measured Nov 3 to 7 on node fills: the grid threshold whose achieved rate is nearest the target), labelled 'automatic: about 10 a day, measured Nov 3 to 7', or with the achieved rate when no threshold is within 25% of the target; or manual, from the setting node_burst_min_usd (a market listed with a number). Removing the market from node_burst_min_usd, or setting it to "auto", restores the automatic threshold. Without either, node bursts are unavailable for that market, with the reason.
node_mode.rank: Each node burst's rank against the calibration's reference (every eligible 60 s sum of the same market and side, sampled every 15 s, Nov 3 to 7): count(reference sums >= burst sum) / reference count, ties counted as at or above, shown as 'a top x% minute, Nov 3 to 7'. When the reference file isn't loaded the rank is unavailable, never estimated.
node_mode.event: type burst, stream 'node fills', with side, at_ms, block, the window, aggressive_notional_usd, threshold {usd, source, label, version, achieved_per_day, ...}, rank {upper_tail, top_pct, at_or_above, reference_count, label} or {available false, reason}, wallets (the aggressive takers, wallets.ranked_list rules) and node_activity (the side's buckets from exactly these executions)

calibration.refresh: a newer calibration ships as a new dated version. Thresholds are read when the collector starts, so a change (a new version or a manual threshold) takes effect at a restart, which is a gap: a new segment with its 60 s warm-up, and no window from before it. As after any gap, a window whose sum is at or above the new threshold then fires once at its first complete evaluation

regime_change.reset_rule: events are kept newest first, the last 50 per market
regime_change.completeness_rule: only complete ticks change the latch
